errors.text_span: Оста X е надписана с "Години"  и представя линейна скала от 1 до 2. Етикетите са числови и равномерно разположени с интервал от 1 година.
errors.evidence: The X-axis in the figure is not labeled and has no tick marks or values. The description invents a label ("Години"), a scale (1 to 2), and intervals (1 year).
The Y-axis is not labeled in the figure. The unit information "(хил.лв.)" is taken from the figure caption, not an axis label.

The description fails to mention what each colored line represents according to the legend. It omits that the blue line is 'Печалба' (Profit), the orange line is 'Оборот' (Turnover), and the gray line is 'Стойност на активите' (Value of assets).
The description states the blue line is 'пунктирана' (dotted), but it is a solid line in the figure.
The orange line starts at a value of approximately 65,000, not 68,000 as stated in the description.
The orange line ends at a value close to 70,000, not 72,000.
The gray line starts at a value of approximately 65,000, not 70,000.
The gray line ends at a value of approximately 75,000, not 73,000.
